body:
As mentioned in #101064 it does seem a bit off to have a getter be mutating stuff, even if what they're mutating is "invalid". Is there any precedence for something like that?

Maybe not removing the invalid exception but instead only doing an `ERR_PRINT_ONCE` and `continue`, just to prevent the spam, would be better? I don't see why anyone should ever be _relying_ on this cleanup to happen, especially with `body_get_object_instance_id` throwing an error anyway.

EDIT: I just realized that not removing the exception would mean that `body_get_object_instance_id` would keep spamming errors, so I guess that wouldn't work.
